recommendations: Create a comprehensive 'Agency Selection Guide' content series to address the recurring agency frustration theme (4+ mentions in existing content)
Develop ROI tracking templates and calculators as lead magnets - only 1 piece addresses the widespread issue that 67% of firms don't track marketing ROI
Launch a 'Marketing Benchmarks Database' comparing costs and results across practice areas - significant demand indicated but minimal current coverage
Produce video content demonstrating intake optimization tactics since speed-to-lead appears multiple times but lacks actionable how-to content
Create practice area-specific marketing playbooks - current content is heavily PI-focused with minimal coverage of other practice areas
Develop an AI readiness assessment tool or guide to capture interest around AI Overviews and ChatGPT impact on legal search
Build comparison content (LSAs vs Avvo vs referrals vs SEO) since lawyers consistently ask about channel prioritization with limited budgets
Address the pending trigger content about employment, staffing, and operational challenges - potential pillar around 'Building Marketing Teams' for law firms
Create intake technology stack recommendations and integration guides to fill the CRM/automation gap
Develop monthly 'Marketing Spend Audit' content analyzing real campaigns to address budget waste and targeting issues
coverage_summary: Current content strongly covers paid advertising pain points and tactical quick wins, particularly for personal injury firms. Mid-level coverage exists for local SEO and lead conversion basics. Significant gaps exist in: (1) Agency relationship management despite high frustration levels, (2) Analytics and ROI tracking methodology, (3) Practice area diversity beyond PI, (4) Emerging channels and AI adaptation strategies, (5) Intake technology and automation, and (6) Strategic decision-making frameworks for budget allocation. The content is reactive (pain point-driven) rather than proactive (educational/strategic), creating opportunities for thought leadership in underserved areas.
